title: Self-adjointness of degree truncation
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f,g:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The uniform inner product of the degree-$k$ truncation of $f$ with $g$ equals the uniform inner product of $f$ with the degree-$k$ truncation of $g$.
